title.th: การเปลี่ยนแปลงทางเทคนิคใน DPIP 26.1
title.vi: Thay đổi kỹ thuật trong DPIP 26.1
title.fil: Mga teknikal na pagbabago sa DPIP 26.1

subtitle.zh_Hant: 以下內容已直接對照現行與 legacy 程式碼，只保留可由實作確認的差異。
subtitle.zh_Hans: 以下内容已直接对照现行与 legacy 代码，只保留可由实现确认的差异。
subtitle.en: Each item was checked directly against the current and legacy code; only implementation-backed differences remain.
subtitle.ja: 現行版と旧版のコードを直接照合し、実装で確認できる差分だけを残しました。
subtitle.ko: 현재 코드와 레거시 코드를 직접 대조해 구현으로 확인되는 차이만 남겼습니다.
subtitle.th: ตรวจสอบแต่ละรายการกับโค้ดปัจจุบันและ legacy โดยตรง และคงไว้เฉพาะความต่างที่ยืนยันได้จากการทำงานจริง
subtitle.vi: Mỗi mục đã được đối chiếu trực tiếp với mã hiện tại và legacy; chỉ giữ lại khác biệt có thể xác nhận từ phần triển khai.
subtitle.id: Setiap item diperiksa langsung terhadap kode saat ini dan legacy; hanya perbedaan yang didukung implementasi yang dipertahankan.
subtitle.fil: Direktang inihambing ang bawat item sa kasalukuyan at legacy code; mga pagkakaibang napapatunayan ng implementation lang ang nanatili.

title.zh_Hant: HTTP 快取與 ETag 驗證
title.zh_Hans: HTTP 缓存与 ETag 验证
title.ja: HTTP キャッシュと ETag 検証
title.th: แคช HTTP และการตรวจสอบ ETag
title.vi: Cache HTTP và xác thực ETag

body.zh_Hant: 全新網址為鍵、ETag 驗證、LRU 位元組預算的 SQLite HTTP 快取。檔案:`core/network/etag_interceptor.dart` + `etag_cache_store.dart`。
body.zh_Hans: 全新网址为键、ETag 验证、LRU 位元组预算的 SQLite HTTP 快取。档案:core/network/etag_interceptor.dart + etag_cache_store.dart。
body.en: A URL-keyed, ETag-validated, LRU byte-budgeted SQLite HTTP cache. Files: core/network/etag_interceptor.dart + etag_cache_store.dart.
body.ja: URL キー、ETag 検証、LRU バイト予算の SQLite キャッシュ。ファイル: core/network/etag_interceptor.dart + etag_cache_store.dart。
body.ko: URL 키, ETag 검증, LRU 바이트 예산 SQLite HTTP 캐시. 파일: core/network/etag_interceptor.dart + etag_cache_store.dart.
body.th: แคช SQLite แบบใช้ URL เป็นคีย์ ตรวจสอบ ETag และจัดงบประมาณแบบ LRU ไฟล์: core/network/etag_interceptor.dart + etag_cache_store.dart
body.vi: Cache HTTP SQLite theo khóa URL, xác thực ETag, ngân sách byte LRU. File: core/network/etag_interceptor.dart + etag_cache_store.dart.
body.id: Cache HTTP SQLite berbasis kunci URL, validasi ETag, anggaran byte LRU. File: core/network/etag_interceptor.dart + etag_cache_store.dart.
body.fil: URL-keyed, ETag-validated, LRU byte-budget SQLite HTTP cache. Files: core/network/etag_interceptor.dart + etag_cache_store.dart.

key.th: การตรวจสอบ

value.zh_Hant: ETag 是唯一 validator;Cache-Control / no-store 被忽略;200 無 ETag 不寫入
value.zh_Hans: ETag 是唯一 validator;Cache-Control / no-store 被忽略;200 无 ETag 不写入
value.en: ETag is the sole validator; Cache-Control/no-store ignored; 200s without an ETag are not cached
value.ja: ETag が唯一のバリデータ。Cache-Control/no-store は無視。ETag なしの 200 はキャッシュしない
value.ko: ETag이 유일한 검증자. Cache-Control/no-store 무시. ETag 없는 200은 캐시 안 함
value.th: ETag เป็นตัวตรวจสอบเดียว; ไม่สนใจ Cache-Control/no-store; 200 ที่ไม่มี ETag จะไม่ถูกแคช
value.vi: ETag là validator duy nhất; Cache-Control/no-store bị bỏ qua; 200 không có ETag không được lưu
value.id: ETag satu-satunya validator; Cache-Control/no-store diabaikan; 200 tanpa ETag tidak dicache
value.fil: ETag lang ang validator; hindi pinapansin ang Cache-Control/no-store; hindi naka-cache ang 200 na walang ETag

key.th: โมเดลการหมดอายุ

value.zh_Hant: 不按時間;只有位元組預算(350 MiB)。30 天前仍被 hit 的 tile 保留位置
value.zh_Hans: 不按时间;只有位元组预算(350 MiB)。30 天前仍被 hit 的 tile 保留位置
value.en: Not time-based; only a byte budget (350 MiB). A tile still being hit after 30 days keeps its place
value.ja: 時間ベースではない。バイト予算のみ (350 MiB)。30 日後もヒット中のタイルは場所を維持
value.ko: 시간 기반이 아님. 오직 바이트 예산(350MiB). 30일 지나도 계속 hit되는 타일은 유지
value.th: ไม่อิงเวลา มีแค่งบประมาณไบต์ (350 MiB) ไทล์ที่ยังถูกเรียกใช้หลัง 30 วันยังคงอยู่
value.vi: Không theo thời gian; chỉ có ngân sách byte (350 MiB). Tile vẫn được gọi sau 30 ngày giữ nguyên vị trí
value.id: Tidak berbasis waktu; hanya anggaran byte (350 MiB). Tile yang masih diakses setelah 30 hari tetap bertahan
value.fil: Hindi time-based; byte budget lang (350 MiB). Nananatili ang tile na ginagamit pa rin kahit 30 araw

key.th: ข้อมูลที่เปลี่ยนแปลงบ่อย

value.zh_Hant: EEW、RTS、location、notify 永不快取——token 不落磁碟
value.zh_Hans: EEW、RTS、location、notify 永不快取——token 不落磁盘
value.en: EEW, RTS, location and notify are never cached — tokens never touch disk
value.ja: EEW・RTS・location・notify は絶対にキャッシュしない。トークンはディスクに落ちない
value.ko: EEW, RTS, location, notify는 절대 캐시 안 함 — 토큰은 디스크에 안 닿음
value.th: EEW, RTS, location, notify ไม่ถูกแคชเด็ดขาด — token ไม่ถูกเขียนลงดิสก์
value.vi: EEW, RTS, location, notify không bao giờ bị cache — token không chạm đĩa
value.id: EEW, RTS, location, notify tidak pernah dicache — token tidak menyentuh disk
value.fil: EEW, RTS, location, notify — hindi kailanman naka-cache; hindi nahahawakan ng disk ang token

key.th: ทรัพยากรที่ไม่เปลี่ยนแปลง

value.zh_Hant: URL 就 pin 住內容:本地 hit 直接 serve,永不發 If-None-Match
value.zh_Hans: URL 就 pin 住内容:本地 hit 直接 serve,永不发 If-None-Match
value.en: The URL pins the content: local hits serve directly, If-None-Match is never sent
value.ja: URL が内容を固定する。ローカルヒットは直接サーブし、If-None-Match は送らない
value.ko: URL이 내용을 고정. 로컬 히트는 바로 서브, If-None-Match는 절대 안 보냄
value.th: URL ยึดเนื้อหาไว้: ฮิตในเครื่องเซิร์ฟโดยตรง ไม่ส่ง If-None-Match เลย
value.vi: URL cố định nội dung: hit cục bộ phục vụ trực tiếp, không bao giờ gửi If-None-Match
value.id: URL mengunci konten: hit lokal langsung disajikan, If-None-Match tidak pernah dikirim
value.fil: Ang URL ang nagla-lock ng content: direktang sineserve ang local hit, hindi na ipinapadala ang If-None-Match

key.th: การจัดการ 304

value.zh_Hant: 空 304 被改寫回帶 cached body 的 200,呼叫者看不到 304
value.zh_Hans: 空 304 被改写回带 cached body 的 200,呼叫者看不到 304
value.en: An empty 304 is rewritten as a 200 with the cached body — callers never see 304
value.ja: 空の 304 はキャッシュボディ付き 200 に書き換えられ、呼び出し元は 304 を見ない
value.ko: 빈 304는 캐시된 body가 있는 200으로 다시 쓰여져, 호출자는 304를 못 봄
value.th: 304 เปล่าแปลงกลับเป็น 200 พร้อม body แคช ผู้เรียกไม่เห็น 304
value.vi: 304 rỗng được viết lại thành 200 kèm body đã cache — caller không bao giờ thấy 304
value.id: 304 kosong ditulis ulang sebagai 200 dengan body cache — pemanggil tidak pernah melihat 304
value.fil: Ang walang laman na 304 ay ginagawang 200 na may cached body — hindi nakikita ng caller ang 304

title.ja: リージョン選択とフェイルオーバー
title.th: การเลือกภูมิภาคและการสลับเมื่อขัดข้อง
title.vi: Chọn vùng và chuyển đổi dự phòng

body.zh_Hant: 舊版會在每次請求隨機選擇編號主機；新版會記住使用者選擇的 LB 與 Core 地區，遇到連線、逾時或 5xx 錯誤時才切換到另一個地區。檔案：core/network/api_region.dart、region_selection.dart。
body.zh_Hans: 旧版会在每次请求随机选择编号主机；新版会记住用户选择的 LB 与 Core 地区，遇到连接、超时或 5xx 错误时才切换到另一个地区。文件：core/network/api_region.dart、region_selection.dart。
body.en: Legacy chose a numbered host at random for each request. The new app remembers the selected LB and Core regions, switching regions only for connection, timeout, or 5xx failures. Files: core/network/api_region.dart and region_selection.dart.
body.ja: 旧版はリクエストごとに番号付きホストをランダム選択していました。新版は選択した LB と Core のリージョンを記憶し、接続・タイムアウト・5xx の場合だけ別リージョンへ切り替えます。ファイル: core/network/api_region.dart、region_selection.dart。
body.ko: 레거시는 요청마다 번호가 붙은 호스트를 무작위로 선택했습니다. 새 버전은 선택한 LB 및 Core 리전을 기억하고 연결·타임아웃·5xx 오류에서만 다른 리전으로 전환합니다. 파일: core/network/api_region.dart, region_selection.dart.
body.th: รุ่นเดิมสุ่มเลือกโฮสต์ที่มีหมายเลขในแต่ละคำขอ รุ่นใหม่จดจำภูมิภาค LB และ Core ที่เลือกไว้ และสลับภูมิภาคเฉพาะเมื่อเกิดข้อผิดพลาดการเชื่อมต่อ หมดเวลา หรือ 5xx ไฟล์: core/network/api_region.dart และ region_selection.dart
body.vi: Bản cũ chọn ngẫu nhiên một host đánh số cho mỗi yêu cầu. Bản mới ghi nhớ vùng LB và Core đã chọn, chỉ đổi vùng khi lỗi kết nối, hết thời gian hoặc 5xx. File: core/network/api_region.dart và region_selection.dart.
body.id: Versi lama memilih host bernomor secara acak untuk setiap permintaan. Versi baru mengingat region LB dan Core yang dipilih, lalu berpindah region hanya saat terjadi kegagalan koneksi, timeout, atau 5xx. File: core/network/api_region.dart dan region_selection.dart.
body.fil: Pumipili ang legacy ng random na numbered host sa bawat request. Inaalala ng bagong bersyon ang napiling LB at Core regions, at nagpapalit lang sa connection, timeout, o 5xx failure. Files: core/network/api_region.dart at region_selection.dart.

key.th: 7 ระดับ

value.zh_Hant: 4 個 tier 可在兩個地區間切換；2 個 tier 固定台南，另有 1 個 legacy 單一主機。LB 與 Core 的選擇會保存。
value.zh_Hans: 4 个 tier 可在两个地区间切换；2 个 tier 固定台南，另有 1 个 legacy 单一主机。LB 与 Core 的选择会保存。
value.en: Four tiers can switch between two regions; two are fixed to Tainan, and one uses a single legacy host. LB and Core selections are persisted.
value.ja: 4 ティアは 2 リージョン間で切替可能、2 ティアは台南固定、残る 1 ティアは単一の legacy ホストです。LB と Core の選択は保存されます。
value.ko: 4개 티어는 두 리전 사이에서 전환할 수 있고, 2개는 타이난에 고정되며, 1개는 단일 레거시 호스트를 사용합니다. LB와 Core 선택은 저장됩니다.
value.th: 4 tier สลับได้ระหว่างสองภูมิภาค 2 tier ยึดที่ไถหนาน และอีก 1 tier ใช้ legacy host เดียว การเลือก LB และ Core จะถูกบันทึกไว้
value.vi: Bốn tier có thể đổi giữa hai vùng; hai tier cố định ở Đài Nam và một tier dùng một host legacy. Lựa chọn LB và Core được lưu lại.
value.id: Empat tier dapat berpindah di antara dua region; dua tier tetap di Tainan, dan satu memakai satu host legacy. Pilihan LB dan Core disimpan.
value.fil: Apat na tier ang maaaring lumipat sa dalawang region; dalawang tier ang nakapirmi sa Tainan, at isa ang gumagamit ng iisang legacy host. Naka-save ang LB at Core selections.

key.ja: フェイルオーバー条件
key.th: เงื่อนไขการสลับ

value.zh_Hant: 只有 connection / timeout / 5xx 換台;4xx 和 user cancel 直接 throw
value.zh_Hans: 只有 connection / timeout / 5xx 换台;4xx 和 user cancel 直接 throw
value.en: Only connection/timeout/5xx trigger a switch; 4xx and user cancellation throw directly
value.ja: 接続・タイムアウト・5xx のみ切り替える。4xx とユーザーキャンセルは直接 throw
value.ko: 연결/타임아웃/5xx만 전환. 4xx와 사용자 취소는 그냥 throw
value.th: เฉพาะ connection/timeout/5xx ที่สลับ; 4xx และการยกเลิกโดยผู้ใช้ throw โดยตรง
value.vi: Chỉ connection/timeout/5xx mới chuyển; 4xx và huỷ do người dùng throw thẳng
value.id: Hanya connection/timeout/5xx yang memicu pindah; 4xx dan cancel user langsung throw
value.fil: Connection/timeout/5xx lang ang nagpapalit; ang 4xx at cancellation ay nag-throw na lang

key.th: กลยุทธ์ timeout

value.zh_Hant: 連線逾時為 8 秒，接收逾時為 10 秒；符合條件時再切換地區。
value.zh_Hans: 连接超时为 8 秒，接收超时为 10 秒；符合条件时再切换地区。
value.en: Connection timeout is 8 seconds and receive timeout is 10 seconds; eligible failures then switch regions.
value.ja: 接続タイムアウトは 8 秒、受信タイムアウトは 10 秒。対象となる失敗時にリージョンを切り替えます。
value.ko: 연결 타임아웃은 8초, 수신 타임아웃은 10초이며 해당 오류에서 리전을 전환합니다.
value.th: หมดเวลาการเชื่อมต่อที่ 8 วินาที และการรับข้อมูลที่ 10 วินาที จากนั้นจึงสลับภูมิภาคเมื่อเป็นข้อผิดพลาดที่เข้าเงื่อนไข
value.vi: Thời gian chờ kết nối là 8 giây và nhận dữ liệu là 10 giây; lỗi đủ điều kiện mới chuyển vùng.
value.id: Timeout koneksi adalah 8 detik dan penerimaan 10 detik; kegagalan yang memenuhi syarat kemudian berpindah region.
value.fil: 8 segundo ang connection timeout at 10 segundo ang receive timeout; saka lang lilipat ng region para sa mga kwalipikadong failure.

title.zh_Hant: SSE 串流取代每秒輪詢
title.zh_Hans: SSE 串流取代每秒轮询
title.ja: SSE ストリームが毎秒ポーリングに取って代わる
title.th: SSE streaming แทนที่การดึงข้อมูลทุกวินาที
title.vi: SSE streaming thay thế kéo dữ liệu mỗi giây
title.id: SSE streaming menggantikan polling per detik
title.fil: Pinapalitan ng SSE streaming ang polling bawat segundo

body.zh_Hant: 核心即時資料傳輸改以 Server-Sent Events 串流。檔案:`core/network/sse_client.dart` + `core/realtime/sse_realtime_source.dart`。
body.zh_Hans: 核心即时资料传输改以 Server-Sent Events 串流。档案:core/network/sse_client.dart + core/realtime/sse_realtime_source.dart。
body.en: Core real-time data moves over Server-Sent Events streaming. Files: core/network/sse_client.dart + core/realtime/sse_realtime_source.dart.
body.ja: 中核のリアルタイムデータ転送が Server-Sent Events ストリーミングに移行。ファイル: core/network/sse_client.dart + core/realtime/sse_realtime_source.dart。
body.ko: 핵심 실시간 데이터 전송이 SSE 스트리밍으로 전환. 파일: core/network/sse_client.dart + core/realtime/sse_realtime_source.dart.
body.th: ข้อมูลเรียลไทม์หลักเปลี่ยนเป็นการส่งแบบ Server-Sent Events ไฟล์: core/network/sse_client.dart + core/realtime/sse_realtime_source.dart
body.vi: Dữ liệu thời gian thực cốt lõi chuyển sang streaming Server-Sent Events. File: core/network/sse_client.dart + core/realtime/sse_realtime_source.dart.
body.id: Transfer data real-time inti beralih ke streaming Server-Sent Events. File: core/network/sse_client.dart + core/realtime/sse_realtime_source.dart.
body.fil: Ang core real-time data ay nasa Server-Sent Events streaming na. Files: core/network/sse_client.dart + core/realtime/sse_realtime_source.dart.

key.th: เหตุการณ์บีบอัด

value.zh_Hant: event: g 事件,data: 是 base64 gzip;資料格式與純 GET 相同,模型不變
value.zh_Hans: event: g 事件,data: 是 base64 gzip;资料格式与纯 GET 相同,模型不变
value.en: event: g events carry base64 gzip data; the payload is identical to the plain GET, so the model never changes
value.ja: event: g イベントの data は base64 gzip。ペイロードは素の GET と同一で、モデルは変わらない
value.ko: event: g 이벤트, data는 base64 gzip. 페이로드는 일반 GET과 동일해서 모델은 그대로
value.th: เหตุการณ์ event: g, data เป็น base64 gzip; รูปแบบข้อมูลเหมือน GET ทั่วไป รุ่นไม่เปลี่ยน
value.vi: Sự kiện event: g, data là base64 gzip; payload giống hệt GET thuần, model không đổi
value.id: Event event: g, data berbentuk base64 gzip; payload sama persis dengan GET biasa, model tak berubah
value.fil: Ang event: g, data ay base64 gzip; kapareho ng plain GET ang payload, hindi nagbabago ang model

key.th: การถอยหลัง

value.zh_Hant: 1s → 2s → cap 在 server retry hint(預設 3s);事件一到立刻歸零
value.zh_Hans: 1s → 2s → cap 在 server retry hint(预设 3s);事件一到立刻归零
value.en: 1s → 2s, capped at the server retry hint (3s default); zeroed instantly on any event
value.ja: 1s → 2s → server の retry ヒント(デフォルト 3s)で上限。イベント到着で即リセット
value.ko: 1s → 2s → 서버 retry 힌트(기본 3s)에서 제한. 이벤트 오면 즉시 초기화
value.th: 1s → 2s → จำกัดที่ค่า retry จากเซิร์ฟเวอร์ (ค่าเริ่มต้น 3s); รีเซ็ตทันทีเมื่อมีเหตุการณ์
value.vi: 1s → 2s, chặn ở hint retry của server (mặc định 3s); về 0 ngay khi có sự kiện
value.id: 1s → 2s, di-cap pada hint retry server (default 3s); seketika nol saat ada event
value.fil: 1s → 2s, may cap sa server retry hint (default 3s); babalik sa zero pagdating ng event

key.th: โหมด liveness สองแบบ

value.zh_Hant: EEW 用 connectionOpen(地震之間無聲);RTS 用 eventRecency 3s 窗(連續 feed)

title.ja: SNTP とモノトニッククロック
title.th: SNTP และนาฬิกาโมโนโทนิก
title.vi: SNTP và đồng hồ đơn điệu

body.zh_Hant: 新版使用主、備 SNTP 來源取得校正時間，再由單調時鐘持續推進；AppTime 對外提供不受手動改鐘影響的時間。檔案：core/realtime/ntp_time_source.dart、server_clock.dart、app_time.dart。
body.zh_Hans: 新版使用主、备 SNTP 来源取得校正时间，再由单调时钟持续推进；AppTime 对外提供不受手动改钟影响的时间。文件：core/realtime/ntp_time_source.dart、server_clock.dart、app_time.dart。
body.en: The new app obtains calibrated time from primary and backup SNTP sources, then advances it with a monotonic clock. AppTime exposes time that is unaffected by manual wall-clock edits. Files: core/realtime/ntp_time_source.dart, server_clock.dart, and app_time.dart.
body.ja: 新版は主・副の SNTP から補正時刻を取得し、その後はモノトニッククロックで進めます。AppTime は手動の時計変更に影響されない時刻を提供します。ファイル: core/realtime/ntp_time_source.dart、server_clock.dart、app_time.dart。
body.ko: 새 버전은 주·백업 SNTP에서 보정 시간을 얻은 뒤 모노토닉 클록으로 진행합니다. AppTime은 수동 시계 변경의 영향을 받지 않는 시간을 제공합니다. 파일: core/realtime/ntp_time_source.dart, server_clock.dart, app_time.dart.
body.th: รุ่นใหม่รับเวลาที่เทียบแล้วจาก SNTP หลักและสำรอง จากนั้นเดินเวลาต่อด้วยนาฬิกาโมโนโทนิก AppTime จึงให้เวลาที่ไม่เปลี่ยนตามการแก้นาฬิกาด้วยตนเอง ไฟล์: core/realtime/ntp_time_source.dart, server_clock.dart และ app_time.dart
body.vi: Bản mới lấy thời gian đã hiệu chỉnh từ SNTP chính và dự phòng, rồi tiếp tục bằng đồng hồ đơn điệu. AppTime cung cấp thời gian không bị ảnh hưởng khi chỉnh đồng hồ hệ thống. File: core/realtime/ntp_time_source.dart, server_clock.dart và app_time.dart.
body.id: Versi baru memperoleh waktu terkalibrasi dari sumber SNTP utama dan cadangan, lalu menjalankannya dengan jam monotonik. AppTime menyediakan waktu yang tidak terpengaruh perubahan jam manual. File: core/realtime/ntp_time_source.dart, server_clock.dart, dan app_time.dart.
body.fil: Kumukuha ang bagong bersyon ng calibrated time mula sa primary at backup SNTP, saka ito pinapatakbo ng monotonic clock. Nagbibigay ang AppTime ng oras na hindi naaapektuhan ng manual clock edits. Files: core/realtime/ntp_time_source.dart, server_clock.dart, at app_time.dart.

key.th: เทียบกับเดิม

value.zh_Hant: Legacy 每分鐘透過 HTTP 時間端點更新 wall-clock offset；新版改用主、備 SNTP，並以單調時鐘推進校正後時間。
value.zh_Hans: Legacy 每分钟通过 HTTP 时间端点更新 wall-clock offset；新版改用主、备 SNTP，并以单调时钟推进校正后时间。
value.en: Legacy refreshed a wall-clock offset from an HTTP time endpoint every minute. The new app uses primary and backup SNTP sources and advances calibrated time with a monotonic clock.
value.ja: 旧版は HTTP 時刻エンドポイントから毎分 wall-clock offset を更新。新版は主・副 SNTP を使い、補正時刻をモノトニッククロックで進めます。
value.ko: 레거시는 HTTP 시간 엔드포인트에서 매분 wall-clock offset을 갱신했습니다. 새 버전은 주·백업 SNTP를 사용하고 보정 시간을 모노토닉 클록으로 진행합니다.
value.th: รุ่นเดิมอัปเดต wall-clock offset จาก HTTP time endpoint ทุกนาที รุ่นใหม่ใช้ SNTP หลักและสำรอง และเดินเวลาที่เทียบแล้วด้วยนาฬิกาโมโนโทนิก
value.vi: Bản cũ cập nhật wall-clock offset từ endpoint thời gian HTTP mỗi phút. Bản mới dùng SNTP chính và dự phòng rồi tiến thời gian đã hiệu chỉnh bằng đồng hồ đơn điệu.
value.id: Versi lama memperbarui wall-clock offset dari endpoint waktu HTTP setiap menit. Versi baru memakai SNTP utama dan cadangan, lalu menjalankan waktu terkalibrasi dengan jam monotonik.
value.fil: Bawat minuto, ina-update ng legacy ang wall-clock offset mula sa HTTP time endpoint. Gumagamit ang bago ng primary at backup SNTP at pinapatakbo ang calibrated time gamit ang monotonic clock.

title.zh_Hant: 保留 24 小時的應用程式日誌
title.zh_Hans: 保留 24 小时的应用程序日志
title.ja: 24 時間保持されるアプリログ
title.th: บันทึกแอปที่เก็บไว้ 24 ชั่วโมง
title.vi: Nhật ký ứng dụng được giữ 24 giờ
title.fil: Application logs na naka-retain nang 24 oras

body.zh_Hant: Log 常駐 SQLite(24h 保留)。重複錯誤抑制:同 signature 5s 窗內重複超過 8 次開始 drop。App 內「日誌」頁可回放崩潰前最後一支。檔案:`core/logging/*`。
body.zh_Hans: Log 常驻 SQLite(24h 保留)。重复错误抑制:同 signature 5s 窗内重复超过 8 次开始 drop。App 内「日志」页可回放崩溃前最后一支。档案:core/logging/*。
body.en: Logs persist in SQLite (24h retention). Repeat-error suppression: more than 8 of the same signature in a 5s window starts dropping. The in-app Log page replays the final moments before a crash. Files: core/logging/*.
body.ja: ログは SQLite に常駐(24 時間保持)。重複エラー抑制:同一シグネチャが 5 秒窓で 8 回超えると削り始める。アプリ内「ログ」ページでクラッシュ直前を再生できる。ファイル: core/logging/*。
body.ko: 로그는 SQLite에 상주(24시간 보존). 반복 오류 억제: 같은 시그니처가 5초 창에서 8회 넘으면 드랍 시작. 앱 내 '로그' 페이지에서 크래시 직전을 재생 가능. 파일: core/logging/*.
body.th: ล็อกอยู่ใน SQLite (เก็บ 24 ชม.) ลดการซ้ำของข้อผิดพลาด: ซ้ำกันเกิน 8 ครั้งในหน้าต่าง 5 วินาทีจะเริ่มตัดทิ้ง หน้า 'Log' ในแอปสามารถย้อนดูช่วงก่อน crash ได้ ไฟล์: core/logging/*
body.vi: Log thường trú trong SQLite (giữ 24h). Chèn lặp lỗi: hơn 8 lần cùng signature trong cửa sổ 5s bắt đầu loại bỏ. Trang 'Nhật ký' trong app xem lại khoảnh khắc cuối trước crash. File: core/logging/*.
body.id: Log menetap di SQLite (retensi 24 jam). Penekanan error berulang: lebih dari 8 kali signature sama dalam jendela 5 detik mulai dibuang. Halaman Log di app memutar ulang momen terakhir sebelum crash. File: core/logging/*.
body.fil: Nananatili ang log sa SQLite (24h retention). Repeat-error suppression: higit sa 8 na parehong signature sa 5s window ay magsisimulang i-drop. Ang in-app Log page ay nag-re-replay ng mga huling sandali bago mag-crash. Files: core/logging/*.

value.zh_Hant: Legacy: talker_flutter 純記憶體,重開機就查不到昨天為何崩潰;新版:SQLite 24h 可回放
value.zh_Hans: Legacy: talker_flutter 纯记忆体,重开机就查不到昨天为何崩溃;新版:SQLite 24h 可回放
value.en: Legacy: talker_flutter in memory — reboot loses the reason behind yesterday's crash; new: SQLite 24h, replayable
value.ja: 旧版: talker_flutter はメモリのみ、再起動で昨日のクラッシュ理由は消える。新版: SQLite 24 時間再生可能
value.ko: 구버전: talker_flutter 메모리 전용, 재부팅되면 어제 크래시 이유 조회 불가. 신버전: SQLite 24시간 재생 가능
value.th: เดิม: talker_flutter หน่วยความจำล้วน รีสตาร์ทแล้วหาสาเหตุ crash เมื่อวานไม่ได้; ใหม่: SQLite 24 ชม. ดูย้อนหลังได้
value.vi: Cũ: talker_flutter chỉ trong bộ nhớ, khởi động lại mất lý do crash hôm qua; mới: SQLite 24h, xem lại được
value.id: Legacy: talker_flutter murni memori, restart hilang sebab crash kemarin; baru: SQLite 24 jam, bisa diputar ulang
value.fil: Legacy: talker_flutter memory lang, mawawala ang dahilan ng crash kahapon pag-restart; bago: SQLite 24h, replayable
